breakdown.description: `IBRION = -1` together with `NSW = 0` turns the run into a static calculation even though the workflow requires a structural relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not fix the incorrect INCAR parameters. The generated specification says to 'Create the INCAR file with the specified parameters,' which refers back to the incorrect parameters (`IBRION = -1`, `NSW = 0`) from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth corrects these to `IBRION = 2` and `NSW = 99` to enable a structural relaxation, a change the agent failed to make.
